simulators.name: Heart Lab
simulators.description: Explore the human circulatory system: the four heart chambers, the one-way valves, and the flow of oxygenated and deoxygenated blood through the lungs and around the body.

simulators.name: Transformer Lab
simulators.description: Take apart a distribution transformer: the core, windings, bushings, radiators, cooling fans, oil conservator, tap changer and more.
